name: San Luis Potosí

plates.name: Current design (2023)
plates.fact: San Luis Potosí's plate is white with lime-green accents, the state name and a QR code up top, and a little skyline of landmark buildings along the bottom.

plates.name: 2026 World Cup commemorative plates
plates.fact: An optional limited edition for the 2026 World Cup in three designs, with the trophy, soccer balls, pitches and a cheeky jaguar mascot, for about 500 pesos.

about: San Luis Potosí plates to hunt, from the state's own sources on 2026-10-26. Not rated yet: every plate is worth the same.

sources.title: State, provincial and territorial licensing agencies, and the plates' sponsors
